title: rosa arvensis var. bibracteata
intro: Rosa arvensis var. bibracteata, commonly known as the Field Rose or Wild Rose, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa arvensis var. bibracteata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
